input.quote: 12.4 Customer shall not solicit, hire, or employ any Vendor employee during the term or for twenty-four months afterward, regardless of how the employee applies.
input.rationale: Section 12.4 imposes a one-sided restrictive covenant on the Customer alone: it is not mutual, covers all Vendor employees rather than only personnel directly involved in the Services, runs for the term plus 24 months rather than 12 months from the end of involvement, expressly extends to hiring and employing (a no-hire), and negates any general-advertisement or unsolicited-approach carve-out ("regardless of how the employee applies"). It fails every fallback element and sits in walk-away territory, so a redline is warranted. It also contradicts § 12.3, in which "Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment." We adopt the preferred position: the operative words are amended so § 12.4 imposes no solicitation, hiring or employment restriction on us, which also removes the internal conflict with § 12.3. The deterministic checks for a 12-month duration and a general-solicitation carve-out are inapplicable on this path because no surviving restriction remains to date-limit or carve out from; a mutual, 12-month, involvement-limited non-solicit with general-advertisement and unsolicited-approach carve-outs and no no-hire is offered in the comment as the negotiating fallback.

ops.oldText: shall not solicit, hire, or employ any Vendor employee during the term or for twenty-four months afterward, regardless of how the employee applies
ops.newText: may solicit, hire, or employ Vendor employees without restriction

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept a one-sided bar on soliciting, hiring or employing any Vendor employee for the term plus 24 months with no general-recruitment carve-out, which also contradicts § 12.3 confirming we gave no no-hire commitment. Our position is no non-solicit on the Customer, so we have removed the restriction; if you need protection we can discuss a mutual 12-month non-solicit limited to personnel directly involved in the Services, with general-advertisement and unsolicited-approach carve-outs and no no-hire.
proposal.summary: Remove the one-sided non-solicit/no-hire on Customer in § 12.4, confirming no restriction.
